title: Tesla reportedly flew scalar-powered vehicles
summary: Steve tells of Tesla reportedly flew scalar-powered vehicles, about early 20th century at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> I think he actually I think he actually flew some rumor has it.

plain: A guest named Steve says that, as rumor has it, the inventor Nikola Tesla actually flew craft powered by scalar energy, a proposed exotic form of power. He ties the claim to a work called Lost Silence. If true, it would mean a kind of advanced flight was achieved early in the 20th century and then forgotten.
